This is an independent review of G05 (PR #135) at `codex/existence-monograph` `bac6004`. **Outcome: changes requested.**
- **Confirmed:** all 241 chapter hashes; the proposed order is a permutation of the include; an independent reference scan finds 0 unresolved and 0 duplicate labels; all 22 symbolic-index entries match their defining text (including C_G = C_𝔤 and λ_G = 2b_0); the C01 drive/response clash, checked in the text and in `Heart.lean`, where `pulse`/`vault` use `levelD` and not `drive`; the Lean anchors in `PublicWilson.lean` and `Extraction/Orders.lean`; no literal circularity in the proofs that the plan defers; the index renders cleanly.
- **R1 (required):** `proposed-total-order.md` puts three producer groups after chapters that use them as premises, and nothing in G05 records this. (1) `ope-grouping`, `ope-grouping-algebra` and `ope-singletons` move from 53–55 to 209–211, but C06/C08/startup chapters at items 13–121 use the connected-set estimate `eq:ope-forest-price` and the singleton construction. (2) `rg-price-receipts` moves from 16 to 62, after `marked-activity-jets` (51). (3) The full-mesh/smooth-limits trio moves to 136–139, after `selected-centered-service` (134). The reorder adds 29 cross-file forward references and removes 28.
- **Minor:** M1 index section pointer for the response 𝒟_{v,a}; M2 exception and block counts disagree between files (58/59, 28/30); M3 unlisted same-file uses before definition; M4 the s_G remark should be refreshed if #138 is accepted.
